text: Shopee's GMV grew 28.0% in FY2024 (from US$78.5 billion in 2023 to US$100.5 billion in 2024) [Sea, FY2024, p.97], while Grab's Deliveries GMV grew 21% in FY2025 (from $11.7 billion in 2024 to $14.2 billion ($14,236 million) in 2025) [Grab, FY2025, p.96, 98]. This means Shopee's GMV growth rate was notably faster — about 7 percentage points higher — than Grab's deliveries GMV growth, even though Shopee's base was already much larger in absolute dollar terms ($100.5B vs. $14.2B).
